Nice place, nice pizza
Sep 2019
A nice place for a pizza. The restaurant was set mostly for ordering and take-away pizza. There are a few tables there for limited people. It was really interesting to be able to see how they make pizza and other dishes. That way, we know that their pizza was really fresh, hot with good ingredients. We had pepperoni pizza on that day. Although I am not a fan of pepperoni pizza because it was salty but Pepperoni pizza there tasted really good, crunchy with thin pizza. It was quite hot at summer when they opened the oven for a while. The staff was really nice and helpful
